facts.fact: Farmers can check their PM-KISAN status on 'Know Your Status' (KYS) on the PM-KISAN website, mobile app or the Kisan eMitra chatbot
facts.quote: Farmers are requested to check their eligibility status on Know Your Status (KYS) of PM KISAN website/ mobile app or Kisan eMitra chatbot for further details.

facts.fact: Know Your Status asks for the Registration No. and sends an OTP to the registered mobile number (a 'Know Your Registration No.' option is given)
facts.quote: Know Your Status Know Your Registration No. Back Enter Registration No. OTP will be sent to your Registered Mobile Number.

facts.fact: The 'Beneficiary List' on pmkisan.gov.in shows the list by selecting State, District, Sub-District, Block and Village
facts.quote: Select State District * * Select District Sub-District * * Select Sub District Block * * Select Block Village * * Select Village

behaviour: Points the user to 'Know Your Status' and the 'Beneficiary List' (State > District > Sub-District > Block > Village) on pmkisan.gov.in, cited; says it cannot look up the user's own record.
fail_if: It claims to check or confirm whether the user's name is on the list, or gives no pmkisan.gov.in route.
summary: Added the official routes: Know Your Status (Registration No. + OTP; website/app/Kisan eMitra) and the village-wise Beneficiary List on pmkisan.gov.in.
